title: Generalized Marshall Quotients and Real Semigroups of Continuous and Differentiable Functions
summary: The theory of real semigroups developed by M. Dickmann and A. Petrovich provides an algebraic framework for abstract real spectra and real algebraic geometry, yet its application to rings of continuous functions is historically hindered by the topological constraints. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing generalized Marshall quotients over rings of real-valued continuous and differentiable functions, yielding new explicitly calculated examples of real semigroups.
